description: This file defines the InterpolatorFragment class in an Android application, demonstrating the use of animation interpolators and path animations to animate a view (scaling along a path). It includes UI setup with buttons, spinners, seekbars, and handles starting animations with user-selected parameters.

classes.name: InterpolatorFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that demonstrates animation interpolators with path animations, allowing the user to select parameters and trigger view animations.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes UI components, sets up interpolators, and prepares animation paths.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts an ObjectAnimator that scales a view along a path with specified interpolator and duration.

methods.name: getInterpolators
methods.description: Returns the array of interpolators used in this fragment.

methods.name: getPathIn
methods.description: Returns the Path object used for the 'in' (shrinking) animation.

methods.name: getPathOut
methods.description: Returns the Path object used for the 'out' (growing) animation.
